name: Checkpoint Recorder
description: Dev-only recorder: captures the full model context (system prompt, history, tools) and the model's resulting decision for each OpenClaw agent run, as one replayable JSON file per run. Read-only observer — never blocks, modifies, or authorizes anything. Load alongside NanCy to compare behavior with/without NanCy in the loop, or alone to record a raw OpenClaw baseline.

outputDir.description: Directory checkpoint JSON files are written to. Default: <rootDir>/captures.

redactPatterns.description: Additional regex source strings (matched globally) to redact from captured content, on top of the built-in secret-shaped patterns (API keys, Bearer tokens, JWT-shaped strings).
